name: auryn-terraform
summary: Terraform/OpenTofu plugin for Auryn and the cloud-topology producer of the deployment & infrastructure tier (ADR 0007). Parses HCL (.tf) into Resource nodes (resource/module/data) and DEPENDS_ON edges from interpolation refs, plus the seams: a container image RUNS_IMAGE the shared Image hub, rds -> Database, aws_ecr_repository -> Registry (PROVISIONS). A deploy-terraform enrichment runs the shared image lifecycle. Composes with docker/compose/k8s onto the same hub. Depends on auryn-core + python-hcl2.
